tool_args.rationale: The five baseline observations show a monotone saturating dependence on u_now. The open-branch pair adds strong, approximately linear gradient-dependent deviations, while the short H=0.6 horizon and fixed remaining covariates do not warrant another probe. Fit the three-parameter saturating-plus-additive-gradient model numerically to all paid rows.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Existing observations span the relevant forecast horizon and identify a compact saturating-response plus gradient-effect model; more trajectory measurements are not presently necessary.
The data do not independently vary past input, state, memory, or horizon, so a coupled dynamical model would be underdetermined and more complex than the observed pattern supports.
The two open-branch observations shift substantially with s_grad at similar u_now, contradicting a gradient-independent recruitment law.
It is unrelated to the target response and explicitly not worth its cost.
